kind: Original firmware RAM and static disassembly; no injected task/event mutation

different_notification_event.note: Do not describe this as clearing the waited event.

gate.sampling: 10 LDRH reads of bit4 per register; returns nonzero if either input never sampled high
gate.physical_names: Not proven. SD driver slot-indexed debounce at 0x064b201c suggests dual card-detect inputs; this is inference, not verified pin naming.
gate.inactive_profile: Explicit hypothetical external input values bit4=1 at these two registers only. No task event or original code patch.
gate.register_note: Generic GPIO config 0x06831bba writes higher config fields to these word addresses; bit4 is sampled input, not the whole register RO.

other_predicates.0x06545536: bit15 if 0x7f082814 bit4 low; bit13 if 0x7f080420 bit4 low
other_predicates.0x065439ea: Classifies ADC-like scalar into bins; input0 maps to3. Physical mode meaning unproven.

limitations: No physical pin names or true board reset levels verified.
Stack code addresses are candidate saved return addresses checked against original call sites, not DWARF unwinding.
GPIO inactive profile removes an artificial active-low condition; it is not evidence that the menu has rendered.
